coverage.main: Read all twenty-seven pages of arXiv 2303.09105v2 (4 March 2024; ICLR 2024 camera-ready header): Sections 1-5, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-4, references and Appendices A-D (proofs, algorithm variants, experimental details C.1 listing the 31 black-box models, Tables C.1-C.5 with other surrogates, Dong et al. and Naseer et al. settings, epsilon = 4/255, DiffPure results, ablations, landscape details).
coverage.supplement: Appendices are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box cells; Figure 4(a-b) loss landscapes; Figures 1-3 illustrations and Bard examples.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.1; Table 1; Figure 4(c); Appendix C Tables C.1-C.5
result_groups.population: NIPS2017 dataset of 1,000 ImageNet-compatible images resized to 224; ensembles of normally and adversarially trained surrogates; 31 black-box models from TorchVision and RobustBench plus 7 defenses (including randomized defenses and DiffPure)
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct or surrogate-success rule is stated.

result_groups.population: INRIA person images; universal patches trained on YOLOv3/YOLOv5 and evaluated on other detectors
result_groups.evidence: Detection mAP has no per-image clean-correct or source-success event.

result_groups.population: 100 random NIPS2017 images; vision-encoder ensemble (ViT-B/16, CLIP, BLIP-2) feature attack; Google Bard
result_groups.outcome: counts of misdescription, blindness and refusal responses
result_groups.evidence: Behavioural outcomes over 100 images; no clean-response baseline or source-success rule stated.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy of the black-box models, clean detector mAP or clean Bard behaviour is reported.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion statement in any scope.

f3.evidence: No surrogate-success restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f4.evidence: Table 3's integers over 100 images are counts; classification rates have no stated denominator; mAP is continuous.

f5.evidence: Classification and Bard attacks state L-infinity epsilon (16/255, 4/255, 32/255); the detector attack is a universal patch without an Lp radius (explicit design).

f6.evidence: The official repository is a broad attack/defense library (286 files) with public models; the Bard target cannot be recomputed. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (286 files, head 23 July 2024; top level README.md, main.py, requirements.txt with attack/defense/model packages). Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: No clean baselines; detection and Bard outcomes are not misclassification probabilities.
